pages.text: A bug swamp: mud floors, shallow pools under Driftmoss and Bladderpads, and Glowmarl banks. $(item)Stiltreed$() trees stand on arching roots with frond caps. Lanternpods and Weepvines hang from the ceiling, and green froglights glow in the crust.
pages.title: Swamp Meteor

pages.text: Glowing bulb that hangs from the ceiling. Bright light (12).
pages.title: Lanternpod

pages.text: A lily pad full of gas. Step on it and it pops into a slowing cloud.
pages.title: Bladderpad

pages.text: Pitcher plant. Slows and nips anything that walks into it, like a berry bush.
pages.title: Snaretongue

pages.text: Tall sweet reed. Mudgrubs love it, and Reedmantises hide in it. Watch for rustling.
pages.title: Sapcane
